blocks.text: Savoy Hotel Mactan Newtown, together with Mercure Mactan Cebu, and Mactan Newtown Beach’s two-day Journey to Ever After: In Bloom bridal fair closed on September 27, 2026, with a sunset bridal fashion show held at the Ceremony Garden of Mactan Newtown Beach. The bridal fair is now in its second year and gathered more than 30 exhibitors and wedding-related partners across the two-day run. A sunset runway for Cebu’s bridal designers With the Mactan Channel as its backdrop, “Journey to Ever After: In Bloom” brought together different interpretations of what bridal fashion can be.
